title: Open Jam @ Prohibition
event_description: Every Tuesday night talented local musicians gather for a long-running open jam. Expect rotating live bands and impromptu sit-ins covering rock blues and classic hits. No cover charge and a packed friendly crowd all night.
event_venue_information:
About Prohibition

Prohibition is a lively Long Island music venue in Massapequa Park known for its live bands excellent sound and a relaxed no-cover atmosphere.

Weekly Music Lineup

Alongside the Tuesday open jam Prohibition hosts Original Music Wednesdays for local songwriters and karaoke with a DJ on Thursdays plus cover bands and acoustic acts on weekends.

The Open Jam

The Tuesday open jam is one of the venue's longest-running traditions. It draws a rotating cast of experienced players and has been hosted over the years by different local musicians who keep the night fresh while maintaining a loyal core of regulars.

Vibe

Reviewers consistently praise the strong sound system outdoor seating area and a welcoming bar staff that makes both regulars and newcomers feel at home.
